canonical_project: CNCA / RNCA Guimaraes Data Center at University of Minho Azurém campus
owner: Fundacao para a Ciencia e a Tecnologia (FCT); DST Group
notes: DST says it is building the National Center for Advanced Computing data center in Guimaraes for EUR5m, located in the Azurém university district, to house advanced computing, University of Minho, European/national supercomputer, and RCTS equipment. DCD reports completion expected in September 2026. Guimaraes is in Braga district; DataCenterMap categorizes the regional market as Porto.
